title: Arthur and Table
statementMd:
Arthur has bought a beautiful big table into his new flat. When he came home, Arthur noticed that the new table is unstable.

In total the table Arthur bought has $*n*$ legs, the length of the $*i*$-th leg is $*l*_{*i*}$.

Arthur decided to make the table stable and remove some legs. For each of them Arthur determined number $*d*_{*i*}$ — the amount of energy that he spends to remove the $*i*$-th leg.

A table with $*k*$ legs is assumed to be stable if there are more than half legs of the maximum length. For example, to make a table with $5$ legs stable, you need to make sure it has at least three (out of these five) legs of the maximum length. Also, a table with one leg is always stable and a table with two legs is stable if and only if they have the same lengths.

Your task is to help Arthur and count the minimum number of energy units Arthur should spend on making the table stable.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the initial number of legs in the table Arthur bought.

The second line of the input contains a sequence of $*n*$ integers $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$), where $*l*_{*i*}$ is equal to the length of the $*i*$-th leg of the table.

The third line of the input contains a sequence of $*n*$ integers $*d*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ 200$), where $*d*_{*i*}$ is the number of energy units that Arthur spends on removing the $*i*$-th leg off the table.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of energy units that Arthur needs to spend in order to make the table stable.
statementZhMd:
亚瑟买了一张漂亮的大桌子搬进了他的新公寓。回家后，亚瑟发现这张新桌子不稳定。

亚瑟买的桌子总共有 $*n*$ 条腿，第 $*i*$ 条腿的长度为 $*l*_{*i*}$。

亚瑟决定通过拆掉一些桌腿来使桌子稳定。对于每条桌腿，亚瑟确定了一个数值 $*d*_{*i*}$——拆掉第 $*i*$ 条腿所需消耗的能量。

如果一张有 $*k*$ 条腿的桌子中，最长的桌腿数量超过桌腿总数的一半，则认为这张桌子是稳定的。例如，要使一张有 $5$ 条腿的桌子稳定，必须保证其中至少有三条（在这五条腿中）长度相同且为最大值的桌腿。此外，只有一条腿的桌子总是稳定的，而有两条腿的桌子当且仅当两条腿长度相同时才稳定。

请帮助亚瑟计算，使桌子稳定所需消耗的最少能量单位数。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$）——亚瑟买来的桌子的初始腿数。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$），其中 $*l*_{*i*}$ 表示桌子第 $*i*$ 条腿的长度。

输入的第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*d*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ 200$），其中 $*d*_{*i*}$ 表示亚瑟从桌子上拆掉第 $*i*$ 条腿所需消耗的能量单位数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——为了使桌子稳定，亚瑟需要消耗的最少能量单位数。
